script.text: Six months after the Dark Signers were defeated, the bridge between New Domino City and Satellite was completed.
The divide between the city and Satellite was no more, and even more importantly, so was the tension between the people of the two districts.
Even though everything seemed peaceful, it wouldn't be long until a new evil arose.
After a meteor in the shape of a card struck the ground near New Domino City, three strangers appeared before it.
Excellent. It has arrived in one piece.
Yes – and already left quite the impression, I’d say.
What else would you expect? It’s my card.
That it is. So I guess you’ll go first.
Let’s not get ahead of ourselves. Remember, there’s a plan that we must follow.
Of course I remember – I came up with it! And it’s perfect.
Hey! Who are you three? What are you doing here?! I order you to vacate these premises now!
And I order you to watch your tongue, worm!
Just who do you think you’re talking to–
Now, now. Is this really how you want to start things off with your new Directors?
New...Directors...?
Yes. The three of us will be sharing the job... as your new bosses!
Oh my word! I’m sorry! No one told me!
I beg your forgiveness!
Meanwhile, Tetsu Trudge paid Yusei, Jack, and Crow a visit.
Don't tell me you guys are still working on that new duel engine prototype.
We sure are! If we can ever get the thing to work right, it will really take our game to the next level.
And that's what it's gonna take to win the Grand Prix.
The toughest, roughest duel contest ever to hit New Domino City.
Since it’s three duelists to a team, creating one new engine design that we can all use is the best way to supe up all our Runners at once.
And guarantee that victory AND dueling immortality will be ours!
What more do you guys have to prove? You already saved the world! If ya ask me, it’s all right for ya to rest on your laurels a bit.
No way! A true duelist never rests! He’s always training and getting better!
That’s right, Crow. But winning the Grand Prix isn’t what I’m training for.
We may have saved the world, but it was too close for comfort.
We nearly lost everything that we care for.
A few days after speaking with Trudge, Yusei was challenged to a Turbo Duel by a mysterious duelist.
Come forth, Yusei Fudo! Come forth and duel me!
Why should I duel you?
You do not have a choice, Yusei Fudo. Your Runner has been tinkered with.
Should you stop while in duel mode, it will explode!
